title: AI Card Grader Evaluation Record
description: Schema for real-world grading outcome records used to evaluate and calibrate the AI grading system.

card_name.description: Human-readable card name (e.g. 'Charizard Base Set Holo')

predicted_grade.description: Grade predicted by the AI system before PSA submission

final_grade.description: Actual PSA/BGS grade received after professional grading

actual_outcome_profit.description: Actual profit/loss realised (slab sale price minus raw cost and grading fee)

predicted_profit.description: Expected profit predicted by the AI ROI engine at time of decision

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the record was created

notes.description: Optional free-text notes (e.g. 'corner wear misidentified as severe')
